# Logistico Tasks & Design Notes

## Source & Mapping

- **ColorLib Source**: Thelogistico (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/thelogistico/`)
- **Live Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/thelogistico/`
- **New App Name**: `logistico` (`@free-react-templates/logistico`)

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

1. **Header / Navbar**: Sticky header with logo, menu links, social icons, phone CTA.
2. **Hero & Quick Offer Form**: Background image overlay, heading, subtitle, explore button, plus interactive offer estimation card.
3. **Services**: 4-column grid of logistics service cards.
4. **About / Accordion (Visit 1-3)**: Transportation details, interactive accordion for road/sea freight, mission quote, shipment control feature list.
5. **Want To Work**: CTA banner for quotes.
6. **Testimonial & Video**: Client quotes, founder info, video popup placeholder icon.
7. **Latest News**: 3-column blog cards with dates and titles.
8. **Brands**: Partner logo carousel/grid.
9. **Footer**: 4-column links + newsletter subscription + Component Dock footer attribution.
